is: the sounds the world's data names (surfaces, rooms, things) and the picker's brief for every sound on a picking page: the catalogue (game/sound/catalogue/) merges each entry over its own, so a field here wins. 'pick' is the picker's alone: the category sets the loudness a take is brought to (tools/sound/loudness/), 'level' is how loud it is played in the game in LUFS (its volume_db is set from it when a take is picked), 'where' is shown on the page, 'search' is what the sources are asked for. A name with no file plays nothing until the owner picks one (tools/sound/picker/)
